lonely yeah. thats the word. i dont even know if its the fear of the scan or just. being so tired of holding it all. like im so so tired. i keep thinking if i just get through this week. but then theres another week. and i dont actually get a break i just keep going. my body literally gave me a warning sign and im still not stopping

That feels like being stuck with no task to finish, while you still have to keep everyone else’s life running.

yeah. that. god its weird seeing it written like that. no task to finish. i think ive been so busy being functional that i never let myself just go like. this is awful and im scared and im allowed to be. nobody in my life has space for me to fall apart so ive just been. not. the scan is thursday btw. so i just have to get through a few more days
